optimizedDescription.value: Indexes multi-workspace code and specs into one graph with unique identities, config-relative lookup, and cross-workspace resolution.

optimizedContext.value:
# Workspace Integration

## Rules

- File/Document identity globally unique:
  - Workspace: `{workspaceName}:{relativeToCodeRoot}` (e.g. `core:src/index.ts`). Name = `SpecdWorkspaceConfig.name`.
  - Root: `root:{projectRelativePath}` (e.g. `root:docs/adr/0001.md`) for project-global `graph.includePaths` not owned by a workspace. `root` reserved.
  - File under workspace `codeRoot`: workspace identity wins. MUST NOT also persist `root:` identity.
  - `path` canonical for `SymbolNode.filePath`, symbol ids, persisted relations.
  - `configRelativePath`: relative to directory of active `specd.yaml`; forward slashes; MUST NOT leading `./`; `..` allowed outside config dir. CLI file selectors MAY resolve unprefixed inputs via this field. Does not replace canonical identity.
- Drive letters not workspace names:
  - String matching `^[A-Za-z]:[/\\]` or `^[A-Za-z]:$` is drive-letter path. Char before first `:` MUST NOT become `{workspaceName}`.
  - Applies to exclusion, hotspot classification, SQLite workspace inclusion, package surfaces, CLI graph display.
  - Workspace filter `C` MUST NOT match drive-letter path or bare `C:`.
- `SymbolNode.id` = `{filePath}:{kind}:{name}:{line}:{column}` (e.g. `core:src/index.ts:function:main:1:0`). `column` disambiguates overloaded declarations on same line.
- `SpecNode.workspace` (`string`): workspace name (e.g. `core`, `_global`). Spec ID `{workspace}:{specPath}` (e.g. `core:change`, `default:_global/architecture`) matching `SpecRepository`. Prefix in specPath from workspace `prefix` in `specd.yaml`.
- Discovery: per workspace `codeRoot` (absolute, `SpecdWorkspaceConfig.codeRoot`). `discoverFiles` workspace-agnostic: root dir in, root-relative paths out. Indexer prefixes workspace name.
- Spec resolution via workspace `SpecRepository` (no CLI precompute/callbacks):
  1. `repo.list()`
  2. `repo.persistedStateHash()` (formerly `specHash`)
  3. Concatenate `repo.artifact()` from `spec.artifacts[].filename`; MUST NOT include metadata or lock sidecars. `spec.md` first if present, then remaining alphabetical by filename.
  4. `repo.metadata()`: `title`, `description`. If `null`: `title` = `specId`, `description` = `''`, `dependsOn` = `[]`. No fallback parsing headings/sections from `spec.md`.
  5. `repo.readPersistedDependsOn()`
  6. `repo.readPersistedImplementation()`
- Pass 2 cross-workspace imports:
  - Relative: same workspace (same path prefix).
  - Package: `packageName → workspaceName` from `LanguageAdapter.getPackageIdentity` (monorepo and multirepo).
  - PHP qualified names: global across all workspaces.
  - `SymbolIndex` holds all workspace symbols before Pass 2.
- Canonical module and package resolution identity:
  - Produce structured workspace, module/package, public-surface, and symbol-space identity from configured code roots and language adapter package facts.
  - Apply language-specific case and visibility rules and supported package/project configuration.
  - MUST NOT infer cross-workspace targets from global same-name match.
  - Changes to workspace roots, package identities, project references, autoload mappings, or other deterministic resolution inputs SHALL change derivation fingerprint and require reindexing.
  - Exact graph file selectors SHALL normalize canonical workspace-relative paths, config/project-relative paths, and absolute paths to same file identity.
  - Wildcard selectors SHALL preserve pattern semantics and MUST NOT be coerced to one file.
- `IndexOptions`: `projectRoot`, `workspaces: readonly ProjectWorkspace[]`, `graphConfig: ProjectGraphConfig`, `onProgress?`, `chunkBytes?`, `vcsRef?`, `vcsRoot: string | null`.
  - `ProjectGraphConfig`: `includePaths?`, `excludePaths?`, `workspaces?: ReadonlyMap<string, { allowedPaths?, excludePaths?, respectGitignore? }>`.
  - Populated by CLI/MCP from `SpecdConfig.graph`.
  - `specs` callback on `WorkspaceIndexTarget` REMOVED. Indexer pulls `SpecRepository` from each `ProjectWorkspace`.
- `IndexResult.workspaces: readonly WorkspaceIndexBreakdown[]`: `name`, `filesDiscovered`, `filesIndexed`, `filesSkipped`, `filesRemoved`, `specsDiscovered`, `specsIndexed`.
- `.gitignore` via `WorkspaceIndexTarget.respectGitignore` (default `true`):
  - `true` + non-null `vcsRoot` (from `VcsAdapter.rootDir()`): load root `.gitignore` and nested `.gitignore` during walk; rules relative to directory containing each `.gitignore`; gitignore exclusion absolute priority — `excludePaths` cannot re-include gitignored files.
  - `vcsRoot` null: do not load repository-root `.gitignore`; MUST NOT probe `.git/`, `.hg/`, `.svn/`.
  - `false`: do not load/apply `.gitignore`; only `excludePaths`.

## Constraints

- `@specd/code-graph` depends on `@specd/core` (types, domain services).
- Single `.specd/code-graph.lbug` for whole project.
- `discoverFiles` workspace-agnostic; indexer owns prefixing and `configRelativePath`.
- Spec resolution exclusively via `SpecRepository`; no filesystem fallback.
- Existing graph stores incompatible when file identity metadata changes (e.g. adding `configRelativePath`) — full rebuild required after upgrading.
